مُرْغَادٌّ part. n. of 11. (L, K.) Milk [that has become commingled, one part with another, but] not yet completely thickened. (L.) [And in like manner, Anything that has become commingled, or confused, one part with another.] ―
-b2- (assumed tropical:) One who is [confused, or] in doubt, in his opinion, or judgment, (JK, S, K,) not knowing how to utter it. (S, K.) ―
-b3- [For its other meanings, see the verb.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
